description: Conversation summary (chat, support, call) — Summarize a chat, support conversation, sales call or team thread: short summary, topic, conversation type, what the customer wanted, decisions, action items with owner and due date, open questions, resolution status (RESOLVED / PENDING / ESCALATE / UNKNOWN), sentiment at start vs end with trend, and risks such as churn or refund demands. Offline checks on top of the model: per-speaker turns, words, share of talk and questions asked; key quotes are verified word-for-word against the transcript (verbatim true/false) and action-item owners are checked against the actual speakers. Lines like 'Name: message' work best (timestamps in [brackets] are fine). Optional focus= to steer the summary. Up to 60,000 characters. Workers AI (llama-3.3-70b); nothing stored. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description:
e.g. Customer: Hi, I have been locked out of my account since Monday and I am pretty frustrated.
Agent Sam: Sorry about that! Can you confirm the email on the account?
Customer: It is jane@example.org
Agent Sam: Thanks, I just sent a password reset link. Did it arrive?
Customer: Yes, it worked. Thank you!

name: ai_conversation_summary
